q: How much does the Partial Risk Sharing Facility guarantee on an energy efficiency loan?
title: PRSF guarantee cover on efficiency loans
short: The Partial Risk Sharing Facility partly guarantees energy saving loans from participating lenders: 40 to 75 percent of the loan amount, or up to ₹15 crore per project, for a tenure of up to 5 years. The World Bank implements it with Clean Technology Fund and Global Environment Facility money, and SIDBI executes it.
audience: MSMEs, ESCOs and lenders financing energy efficiency projects

ul: World Bank: implementing agency, with funding from the Clean Technology Fund and the Global Environment Facility.
BEE: co-chairs the advisory committee and gives policy guidance.
Participating financial institutions: make the loans that the facility partly guarantees.

p: Each energy saving loan from a participating lender is partially guaranteed for a maximum tenure of 5 years, with coverage of 40 to 75 percent of the loan amount or ₹15 crore per project. The guarantee protects the lender against part of its loss on default.

sections.h: What it means for the borrower
p: You do not apply to PRSF. You borrow from a participating bank or NBFC, often for a project delivered by an ESCO, and the lender seeks the guarantee. It can make a lender more willing to finance a project with limited collateral, but you still owe the full amount. Ask whether any guarantee fee is passed on to you.

sections.h: Check before you plan around it
p: Facilities like this run in funding rounds. BEE points to SIDBI's PRSF website for current terms, so confirm with SIDBI or your lender that it is taking new projects.

senseible: Senseible records energy before and after the project from your bills, the savings evidence lenders under a guarantee programme report on.
